circuit.name: Half Bridge DC-DC Converter
circuit.description: Isolated half-bridge converter with high-frequency transformer isolation. Primary: Split capacitors (C1, C2) with two NMOS switches (SW1 high-side with floating drive, SW2 low-side). Secondary: Center-tapped rectification with two diodes (DR1, DR2) and LC output filter. External antiparallel diodes (D1, D2) for visualization and protection.

requirements.requirement: Startup transient from 0V to steady-state output voltage. Converter is NON-INVERTING half-bridge with center-tapped secondary rectification. Measure VOUT at [R_LOAD, pos] or [C_OUT, pos] (positive output terminal). Verify output reaches target voltage with acceptable overshoot and settling time.

environment.description: 15ms simulation time for startup settling (1000+ switching periods at typical 100kHz)

data.name: t_settle
data.description: Time when output settles to within 5% of target (last crossing)

measurement.description: Output voltage measurement for startup transient analysis

outputs.description: Steady-state output voltage in volts
Output voltage overshoot percentage
Settling time in milliseconds

requirements.requirement: Line regulation test: Input voltage step from nominal to high line. Measure output voltage deviation and recovery time. Converter maintains regulation across input voltage range.

environment.description: 15ms simulation: 5ms startup + 5ms nominal + 5ms after input step
Input voltage step from 24V to 30V at t=5ms to test line regulation

data.name: vout_before
data.description: Output voltage before input step (1ms after start)

data.name: vout_after_min
data.description: Minimum output voltage after input step

data.name: vout_after_steady
data.description: Steady-state output voltage after input step

data.name: t_recovery
data.description: Recovery time to within 5% of target (last crossing)

measurement.description: Output voltage for line regulation test

outputs.description: Maximum output voltage deviation percentage during line step
Recovery time in milliseconds

requirements.requirement: Load transient response: Step load change from light to heavy load. Measure output voltage undershoot/overshoot and recovery time. Verify output filter (L_OUT, C_OUT) provides adequate transient response.

environment.description: 15ms simulation: 5ms startup + load step at 5ms + 10ms recovery observation

data.name: vout_before_load
data.description: Output voltage before load step (1ms after start)

data.name: vout_min_load

data.name: vout_max_load
data.description: Maximum output voltage during load transient (overshoot)

data.name: vout_after_load
data.description: Steady-state output voltage after load step

data.name: t_recovery_load

measurement.description: Output voltage for load transient test

Output voltage overshoot percentage
Load transient recovery time in milliseconds

outputs.description: Maximum drain-source voltage on SW1 in volts
Maximum drain-source voltage on SW2 in volts

Peak drain current on SW2 in amperes

environment.description: 15ms simulation to capture rectifier stress in steady-state

outputs.description: Maximum reverse voltage across DR1 in volts

outputs.description: Average output inductor current in amperes

Primary: Split capacitors (C1, C2) with two NMOS switches (SW1 high-side with floating drive, SW2 low-side). Secondary: Center-tapped rectification with two diodes (DR1, DR2) and LC output filter. External antiparallel diodes (D1, D2) for visualization and protection.

requirements.requirement: Startup transient from 0V to steady-state output voltage. Converter is NON-INVERTING half-bridge with center-tapped secondary rectification. Measure VOUT at [R_LOAD, pos] or [C_OUT, pos] (positive output terminal). Verify output reaches target voltage with acceptable overshoot and settling time.

environment.description: 15ms simulation time for startup settling (1000+ switching periods at typical 100kHz)

data.name: t_settle
data.description: Time when output settles to within 5% of target (last crossing)

measurement.description: Output voltage measurement for startup transient analysis

outputs.description: Steady-state output voltage in volts
Output voltage overshoot percentage
Settling time in milliseconds

requirements.requirement: Line regulation test: Input voltage step from nominal to high line. Measure output voltage deviation and recovery time. Converter maintains regulation across input voltage range.

environment.description: 15ms simulation: 5ms startup + 5ms nominal + 5ms after input step
Input voltage step from 24V to 30V at t=5ms to test line regulation

data.name: vout_before
data.description: Output voltage before input step (1ms after start)

data.name: vout_after_min
data.description: Minimum output voltage after input step

data.name: vout_after_steady
data.description: Steady-state output voltage after input step

data.name: t_recovery
data.description: Recovery time to within 5% of target (last crossing)

measurement.description: Output voltage for line regulation test

outputs.description: Maximum output voltage deviation percentage during line step
Recovery time in milliseconds

requirements.requirement: Load transient response: Step load change from light to heavy load. Measure output voltage undershoot/overshoot and recovery time. Verify output filter (L_OUT, C_OUT) provides adequate transient response.

environment.description: 15ms simulation: 5ms startup + load step at 5ms + 10ms recovery observation

data.name: vout_before_load
data.description: Output voltage before load step (1ms after start)

data.name: vout_min_load
data.description: Minimum output voltage during load transient (undershoot)

data.name: vout_max_load
data.description: Maximum output voltage during load transient (overshoot)

data.name: vout_after_load
data.description: Steady-state output voltage after load step

data.name: t_recovery_load
data.description: Recovery time to within 5% of target (last crossing)

measurement.description: Output voltage for load transient test

outputs.description: Output voltage undershoot percentage
Output voltage overshoot percentage
Load transient recovery time in milliseconds

requirements.requirement: Efficiency measurement at nominal operating point. Calculate Pin (input power from VIN) and Pout (output power to R_LOAD). Measure transformer losses, switching losses (SW1, SW2), and rectifier losses (DR1, DR2). Target efficiency >85% for isolated half-bridge topology.

environment.description: 15ms simulation for steady-state efficiency measurement

outputs.description: Input power in watts
Output power in watts
Converter efficiency percentage

requirements.requirement: Primary-side switch voltage and current stress. Measure peak drain-source voltage (Vds_peak) on SW1 and SW2 to verify MOSFETs are not overstressed. Measure peak switch current (Id_peak) for thermal and SOA analysis. Verify antiparallel diodes (D1, D2) conduct during dead-time.

environment.description: 15ms simulation to capture steady-state switching stress

outputs.description: Maximum drain-source voltage on SW1 in volts
Maximum drain-source voltage on SW2 in volts
Peak drain current on SW1 in amperes
Peak drain current on SW2 in amperes

requirements.requirement: Secondary-side rectifier diode stress. Measure peak reverse voltage (Vr_peak) across DR1 and DR2 to verify diode voltage rating. Measure peak forward current (If_peak) for thermal design. Center-tapped rectification causes each diode to block full secondary voltage during off-state.

environment.description: 15ms simulation to capture rectifier stress in steady-state

outputs.description: Maximum reverse voltage across DR1 in volts
Maximum reverse voltage across DR2 in volts
Peak forward current through DR1 in amperes
Peak forward current through DR2 in amperes

environment.description: 15ms simulation with fine timestep to capture high-frequency ripple

data.description: Average output voltage for ripple calculation

environment.description: 15ms simulation to measure inductor current in steady-state

outputs.description: Average output inductor current in amperes
Peak output inductor current in amperes
Peak-to-peak inductor current ripple in amperes

External antiparallel diodes (D1, D2) for visualization and protection.

requirements.requirement: Startup transient from 0V to steady-state output voltage. Converter is NON-INVERTING half-bridge with center-tapped secondary rectification. Measure VOUT at [R_LOAD, pos] or [C_OUT, pos] (positive output terminal). Verify output reaches target voltage with acceptable overshoot and settling time.
